note: Graphics settings (roadmap item 37; ui/play/graphics_settings.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). A quality preset sets three things: `pixel_scale` (how many screen pixels one pixel of world art covers in the 3D renderer to come: a bigger number draws fewer pixels), `effects` (off, some or all: which decorative effects are drawn) and `fps_cap` (frames a second, 0 for as fast as the screen refreshes). The battery saver lies over whichever preset is chosen: its frame cap unless the preset's is lower, effects off, and the engine's low-processor mode, which redraws only when something changes. The choice is kept in settings.cfg, never in the save. An effect names the level it needs (`effect_levels`): `weather_particles` (rain, snow and embers in a fight's painted scene) is drawn at some and all. `pixel_scale` has nothing to read it until the 3D renderer exists.

low.name: Low
low.about: Fewest pixels, no weather effects, 30 frames a second.

high.name: High
high.about: Sharpest picture, every effect, as fast as the screen refreshes.

battery_saver.about: At most 30 frames a second, no effects, and the screen is redrawn only when something changes.
